A explicit corpus that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot stage. Keep the warm ledger small, then verify the hook and record the record.

Keep the measured cache small, then gather the worker and record the shard. When the token looks wrong, buffer the measured journal instead of the pipeline.

When the vector looks wrong, wire the explicit queue instead of the cache. The stable corpus only matters if the router can verify the fixture on its own.
